shared_elements: broad collar or necklace-like band (A) / bodily adornment
justification: Both surfaces carry dense inscriptions in what appears to be the same repertoire of pictorial signs arranged in ordered columns/rows, and both include a disc motif and human figures with long wigs, which suggests a shared sign-writing and figural convention. The biggest difference in depicted content is that B presents a framed arched scene with a rayed disc above adoring figures over blocks of text, whereas A depicts a single sculpted torso with a pendant disc and collar, with the signs applied over the body rather than composing a scene.
